m01:room.title: The Metabolism Glasshouse
m01:room.job: Find out if a sick cassava leaf loses carbon over a whole day.

m02:room.title: The Root Transport House
m02:room.job: Find a rinse that leaves a root cell the way it is.

m03:room.title: The Signal Imaging Lab
m03:room.job: Find out if the border roots have slowed, and what they react to.

m04:room.title: The Expression Glasshouse
m04:room.job: Find out how much more defense RNA the dosed root makes, and if its DNA changed.

m05:room.title: The Crossing House
m05:room.job: Find out how Family 2 passes on its resistance.

m06:room.title: The Linkage Analysis Trailer
m06:room.job: Find out how often marker B splits from the resistance gene.

m07:room.title: The Sequence and Protein Lab
m07:room.job: Find which codon holds the changed base, and what it now codes for.

m08:room.title: The River Pathology Lab
m08:room.job: Find how much PV-7 is in the root, and test whether it causes the rot.

m09:room.title: The Challenge Phenotyping House
m09:room.job: Find how much each line blocks the germ's enzyme, and how well each yields.

m10:room.title: The Seed Vault Atrium
m10:room.job: Find how common the R1 allele is in the crate, and what Hardy-Weinberg predicts.

m11:room.title: The Evolution Trial Canopy
m11:room.job: Find how fit the ordinary strains are under the spray, and the new resistant share.

m12:room.title: The River Ecology Station
m12:room.job: Find how fast the rot is spreading in one block, and where PV-7 is in the water.

m13:room.title: The Rhizosphere House
m13:room.job: Find how much of the root the fungus reaches, and a thread's surface for its size.

m14:room.title: The River Mesocosm Hall
m14:room.job: Find what oxygen a tank makes, and how much is left at dawn.

m15:room.title: The Harvest Decision Room
m15:room.job: Find how many seedlings truly carry R, and how much oxygen the aerators must add.
